heroic-games-launcher on Omarchy

One free launcher for your Epic, GOG, and Amazon Prime game libraries.

Package data synced 2026-10-19 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install heroic-games-launcher on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add heroic-games-launcher-bin. It is a 150.6 MB download (387.2 MB installed), version 2.22.4-1, licensed GPL-3.0-only. An Open source Launcher for Epic, Amazon and GOG Games. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install heroic-games-launcher on Omarchy

Heroic Games Launcher is a free, open-source alternative launcher for Linux, Windows, and macOS (plus Steam Deck) that brings your Epic Games, GOG, and Amazon Prime Gaming libraries together in one app. It handles downloads and install queues with live progress, lets you manage Wine/Proton compatibility tools for running Windows games, offers a controller-friendly full-screen console mode for TVs and handhelds, and supports custom cover art and multiple language and theme options.

Watch: Heroic Games Launcher on Linux Demo ↗

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add heroic-games-launcher-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 2.22.4-1:
    pacman -Qi heroic-games-launcher-bin

Open and use heroic-games-launcher

heroic-games-launcher is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql heroic-games-launcher-bin | grep applications

heroic-games-launcher requirements and compatibility

  • Accounts on whichever storefronts you want to use: Epic Games, GOG, and/or Amazon Prime Gaming
  • Network access to those storefronts

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • which
  • gtk3

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-3.0-only.

Frequently asked questions

How do I install heroic-games-launcher on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add heroic-games-launcher-bin. The download is 150.6 MB and it takes 387.2 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is heroic-games-launcher free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-3.0-only.

How do I uninstall heroic-games-launcher?

Run omarchy pkg drop heroic-games-launcher-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does heroic-games-launcher depend on?

The package declares 2 dependencies: which, gtk3. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is heroic-games-launcher a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for heroic-games-launcher.

Is heroic-games-launcher in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as heroic-games-launcher-bin (version 2.22.4-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. Heroic Games Launcher makes it. Project site: https://heroicgameslauncher.com/.
